Chicken and cheese provide a generous protein portion, and both contribute phosphorus. Tomato-based sauce adds potassium too, so look at the complete serving if you monitor either mineral.

beef-fajita-platter-with-tortillas.text: About this meal: Sizzling beef and peppers are lovely with soft tortillas and cooling lime yoghurt. Beef supplies protein and phosphorus, while tortillas provide carbohydrate. Pepper and onion do a lot of the flavouring, so you don't need a salty fajita seasoning sachet.

caribbean-chicken-curry-with-rice.text: About this meal: Allspice, thyme and ginger make this Caribbean-style chicken curry fragrant, while potato and rice make it especially filling. The potato contributes potassium, so its portion matters if you're following potassium advice. Chicken provides plenty of protein alongside the vegetables.

jollof-style-rice-with-grilled-chicken.text: About this meal: Jollof-style rice gets its deep flavour from tomato, pepper and gentle spices, with grilled chicken providing protein. Tomato-based rice can contribute potassium, especially in a generous serving. The whole plate is the helpful measure if potassium is something you're monitoring.

light-chicken-stew-with-seasoned-rice.text: About this meal: Ginger and gently cooked tomato bring warmth to this chicken stew, while seasoned rice soaks up the sauce. Chicken supplies protein and rice provides carbohydrate. Tomato and the other vegetables contribute potassium, so the complete serving is useful if you're managing it.

homemade-chicken-and-spinach-cannelloni.text: About this meal: Spinach, ricotta and chicken make these cannelloni wonderfully comforting, with tomato sauce and a creamy topping. Chicken, cheese and milk provide substantial protein and phosphorus, while spinach and tomato contribute potassium. It's a rich dish with several mineral sources, so the whole-serving figures are worth noticing.

chicken-and-pepper-paella.text: About this meal: Saffron, paprika and peppers make chicken paella colourful and satisfying without a shop-bought mix. Chicken provides protein, rice supplies carbohydrate, and vegetables add colour and some fibre. Tomato contributes potassium, so its presence is already reflected in the complete meal's values.

chicken-and-mushroom-puff-pastry-pie.text: About this meal: Chicken and mushrooms make a lovely creamy filling under crisp puff pastry. Chicken provides protein, while butter, cream and pastry give the pie its richness and energy. Mushrooms contribute potassium, but the recorded figure describes the whole serving rather than just the filling.

paprika-pork-goulash-with-buttered-noodl.text: About this meal: Paprika and caraway give pork goulash its warming flavour, with buttery noodles making it comforting. Pork supplies protein and phosphorus, while noodles and butter add carbohydrate and energy. Tomato and pepper contribute potassium, so use the full serving figure if you monitor it.

roasted-pepper-and-white-bean-lasagne.text: About this meal: Roasted peppers and white beans make this lasagne hearty without meat, while ricotta and walnuts add richness. Beans bring fibre and plant protein; the cheese and nuts also contribute phosphorus. The recipe's complete nutritional figures are more useful than judging any one filling ingredient alone.

turkey-and-leek-pie-with-walnut-pastry.text: About this meal: Leeks, thyme and tender turkey give this pie a comforting flavour, with walnuts adding a little richness to the pastry. Turkey provides protein, while milk and walnuts contribute phosphorus. It's a satisfying dish that offers more variety than simply trying to make every dinner low in every nutrient.

cod-and-parsley-cakes-with-warm-rice-sal.text: About this meal: Crisp cod-and-parsley cakes are lovely with a fresh cabbage-and-rice salad. Cod and egg white provide protein, while walnuts add crunch and plant fats. The measured mayonnaise contributes to the salt and fat totals, so the dressing is worth keeping in mind if you use a different brand.

vegetable-and-chickpea-tagine-with-almon.text: About this meal: Warming cumin and cinnamon make this chickpea tagine fragrant, while almonds add crunch to the couscous. Chickpeas supply fibre and plant protein as well as potassium and phosphorus. If you monitor these minerals, the whole-serving totals help you include pulses thoughtfully rather than avoid them outright.

ricotta-and-walnut-ravioli-with-basil-an.text: About this meal: Homemade ricotta-and-walnut ravioli is a lovely special-occasion dinner, with basil and lemon keeping it fresh. Ricotta and walnuts contribute phosphorus, while the pasta supplies carbohydrate. The nuts contain naturally occurring plant phosphorus, which behaves differently from phosphate additives.

baked-fish-with-green-rice-and-lime-slaw.text: About this meal: Coriander rice and lime slaw make a bright contrast with baked cod. The fish provides protein, and avocado adds creaminess and potassium. If you manage potassium, the complete serving figure matters more than treating avocado as something you can never enjoy.

turkey-mushroom-and-walnut-pilaf.text: About this meal: Turkey, mushrooms and toasted walnuts make this rice pilaf deeply savoury, with lemon and yoghurt adding freshness. Turkey provides protein, while walnuts contribute plant fats and phosphorus. If phosphorus is on your radar, it's worth considering the nuts and dairy alongside the turkey rather than focusing on just one ingredient.

hake-and-coconut-rice-bake-with-crisp-sl.text: About this meal: Coconut gives this hake-and-rice bake a gentle sweetness, balanced by crisp lime slaw. Hake provides protein, while egg white helps bind the bake without adding another yolk. The slaw adds welcome vegetables and freshness without a heavy bottled dressing.

pork-and-apple-skewers-with-herbed-cousc.text: About this meal: Pork and apple are a lovely combination on skewers, especially with thyme and lemon. Couscous makes the meal satisfying, while cabbage and walnuts add texture. Pork provides protein and phosphorus; the walnuts add plant fats and some more phosphorus.

cabbage-rolls-with-barley-mushrooms-and-.text: About this meal: These cabbage rolls are packed with barley, mushrooms and seitan, making them hearty without meat. Seitan supplies concentrated wheat protein, and barley adds fibre. Walnuts contribute plant fats and phosphorus, so the full serving is worth looking at if you're managing minerals.

mild-tofu-and-coconut-curry-with-basmati.text: About this meal: Ginger, cumin and lime give this tofu-and-coconut curry warmth, with rice making it a complete meal. Tofu provides plant protein, and coconut adds richness. Plain tofu is the ingredient used here; pre-marinated versions can add considerably more salt.

turkey-kebabs-with-flatbread-and-cucumbe.text: About this meal: Cumin, coriander and lemon make these turkey kebabs fragrant, with cool cucumber yoghurt balancing the spice. Turkey and egg white supply substantial protein. The whole serving has a meaningful potassium and phosphorus contribution, so use the numbers if either nutrient is part of your personal guidance.

basil-and-ginger-tofu-cakes-with-rice-an.text: About this meal: Ginger, basil and lime make these tofu cakes fresh and savoury, while rice and cabbage give plenty of texture. Tofu supplies plant protein and peanuts add crunch and phosphorus. Soy sauce contributes salt; check reduced-salt versions for potassium substitutes if that's a concern.

sesame-salmon-with-rice-noodles-and-crun.text: About this meal: Sesame and ginger bring out salmon's rich flavour, while crunchy cabbage and carrot lighten the noodles. Salmon provides protein and omega-3 fats; sesame seeds add phosphorus and texture. Soy sauce contributes salt even in a homemade dressing, so its measured portion matters.

black-bean-and-rice-stuffed-peppers.text: About this meal: Black beans, rice and Cheddar make these stuffed peppers satisfying, with avocado and lime adding freshness. Beans provide fibre, while cheese adds protein and phosphorus. The recorded potassium is substantial, so this is one to consider carefully if you're monitoring potassium—not a reason to ban beans or avocado outright.

beef-pepper-and-onion-saltado-with-rice.text: About this meal: Beef saltado-style rice is full of flavour from pepper, onion, garlic and a splash of vinegar. Beef provides protein, while avocado adds creaminess and potassium. Soy sauce contributes salt, and the whole serving has a sizeable potassium estimate if you're tracking that nutrient.

fish-and-groundnut-stew-with-rice.text: About this meal: Peanuts give this warmly spiced fish stew a rich, nutty body, while lime and ginger keep it lively. Cod provides protein, and the peanuts add plant fats and phosphorus. Rice makes the bowl satisfying without needing a salty stock cube.

lentil-bobotie-with-rice.text: About this meal: Lentils, apple and warm spices give this bobotie a lovely sweet-savoury flavour under its egg topping. Lentils bring fibre and plant protein; the whole egg and extra white add more protein. Walnuts and milk contribute phosphorus, so it's worth using the complete meal figure if you monitor it.

salmon-and-courgette-frittata.text: About this meal: Salmon, courgette and Cheddar make a rich frittata with plenty of protein. Salmon supplies beneficial omega-3 fats, while cheese and egg contribute phosphorus as well. If you're monitoring phosphorus, this is one to compare with your own targets rather than assuming that a vegetable-filled omelette must be low in it.

garlic-cream-chicken-with-braised-cabbag.text: About this meal: Garlic, thyme and lemon give this creamy chicken-and-cabbage dish plenty of flavour. Chicken provides protein, while cream adds richness and energy. It's satisfying without a starchy accompaniment, so think about where fibre and carbohydrate fit into your wider eating pattern if those matter for you.

pork-medallions-with-creamy-courgettes.text: About this meal: Pork medallions are lovely with soft courgettes and a little cream, especially with garlic and thyme. Pork provides protein and phosphorus, while the cream contributes richness. Courgette also adds potassium, but the measured amount is already included in the figure for the whole dish.

turkey-patties-with-avocado-and-cabbage-.text: About this meal: Turkey patties, crunchy cabbage and creamy avocado make a lovely fresh combination. Turkey and egg white provide plenty of protein, while avocado supplies healthy fats and potassium. The recorded potassium is substantial, so consider the portion in the context of your own advice if you monitor it.

egg-and-cheddar-stuffed-mushrooms.text: About this meal: Mushrooms make a delicious base for an egg-and-Cheddar filling, with chives and parsley brightening the flavour. Eggs, cheese and cream all contribute phosphorus, making this a particularly noteworthy figure if you monitor it. There's no need to add a salty sauce to this rich filling.

salmon-and-egg-bake.text: About this meal: Salmon and egg make a rich, protein-packed bake, with beneficial omega-3 fats from the fish. Both also contribute phosphorus, so the recorded amount deserves a look if you monitor it. This recipe has no plant accompaniment, so enjoy fruit, vegetables or wholegrains elsewhere if they fit your advice.

beef-patties-with-poached-eggs.text: About this meal: Beef patties and poached eggs make a hearty, protein-rich plate. Both ingredients contribute phosphorus, and there's little fibre because no vegetables or grains are included. If you enjoy this style of meal, it's worth allowing room for more variety across the day.

chicken-thigh-and-egg-casserole.text: About this meal: Chicken thigh and egg make this casserole rich in protein, with a little butter adding flavour. Both the chicken and egg contribute phosphorus. As there are no vegetables or grains in the recipe, you may want to look for fibre and variety elsewhere in your meals.

cod-and-salmon-egg-custard.text: About this meal: Cod, salmon and egg make a delicate savoury custard with a generous amount of protein. Salmon also provides omega-3 fats, while both fish and egg contribute phosphorus. There's no vegetable accompaniment here, so it's worth considering how the meal fits into a varied day of eating.

chicken-and-potato-frittata-with-carrots.text: About this meal: Chicken and egg give this potato frittata plenty of protein, while carrots and chives bring sweetness and freshness. The potato has been boiled and drained before use, an important detail for the potassium estimate. If you're following potassium advice, the whole-serving number matters.

salmon-with-carrot-rice-and-cucumber-sal.text: About this meal: Salmon with lemony carrot rice and cool cucumber is a fresh, satisfying dinner. The salmon provides protein and omega-3 fats, while rice supplies carbohydrate. The carrot and cucumber add vegetables without needing a salty bottled dressing.

turkey-and-chive-meatballs-with-polenta.text: About this meal: Turkey-and-chive meatballs make a comforting dinner beside soft polenta and carrots. Egg white helps bind the meatballs while adding protein without another yolk. Thyme and chives do the flavouring, so there's no need for a salty packet sauce.

crisp-cod-with-basil-polenta-and-carrots.text: About this meal: A crisp rice-flour coating makes cod feel like a treat, with soft basil polenta and carrots alongside. Fish and egg white provide protein, while the polenta offers carbohydrate. Lemon and basil give plenty of flavour without a ready-made seasoning mix.

ginger-egg-and-carrot-fried-rice.text: About this meal: Ginger and chives make this egg fried rice fragrant, with carrots and spinach adding colour. The extra egg whites increase protein without needing more yolks. Spinach contributes potassium, but its measured portion is included in the complete meal figure.

spiced-lentil-and-brown-rice-pilaf.text: About this meal: Lentils and a little brown rice make this pilaf hearty, with cumin, ginger and coriander adding warmth. The lentils bring fibre and plant protein, though this serving isn't as protein-rich as some meat-based dinners. Naturally occurring phosphorus in pulses is absorbed differently from phosphate additives.

lemon-seitan-with-white-bean-barley-pila.text: About this meal: Seitan gives this lemony barley pilaf a useful protein boost, while white beans and wholegrains add fibre. Fresh parsley and pepper keep it lively without a salty sauce. Seitan here is made from vital wheat gluten; ordinary wheat flour isn't an equivalent substitute.

tofu-white-bean-and-barley-bake.text: About this meal: Tofu, white beans and barley make this bake hearty and fibre-rich, with tomato and basil bringing freshness. Both beans and tofu provide plant protein and contribute phosphorus. Their potassium is included in the recorded serving, so pulses can be considered in context rather than excluded by default.

spinach-and-egg-brown-rice-bake.text: About this meal: Spinach and chives bring freshness to this creamy egg-and-rice bake. Whole egg and extra whites provide plenty of protein without relying on a large amount of cheese; yoghurt adds a gentle tang. Spinach, milk products and egg all contribute to the mineral totals, which are worth checking if you monitor them.

lentil-and-walnut-bobotie-with-rice.text: About this meal: Warm spices, apple and raisins give this lentil bobotie a lovely sweet-savoury flavour, with walnuts adding crunch. Lentils bring fibre and plant protein, while egg and extra whites boost the protein further. The meal also contributes phosphorus, so use the whole-serving figure if you're monitoring it.

white-bean-and-ricotta-stuffed-peppers-w.text: About this meal: White beans and ricotta make these stuffed peppers creamy and satisfying, with rice alongside and basil keeping the filling fresh. Beans contribute fibre, while cheese and walnuts add phosphorus. The potassium total is substantial, so it's one to consider in your own plan rather than assume stuffed vegetables must be low in it.

peanut-and-lime-fish-noodles.text: About this meal: Lime, ginger and peanuts make these cod noodles bright and savoury. Cod provides protein, while peanuts add crunch, plant fat and phosphorus. Soy sauce also contributes salt; if you're watching potassium, check reduced-salt alternatives for potassium-based substitutes.

beef-and-black-eyed-pea-stew-with-polent.text: About this meal: Beef and black-eyed peas make this stew substantial, with soft polenta soaking up the spiced tomato sauce. Beef provides protein and phosphorus, while peas add fibre and plant protein. The recorded potassium is fairly high, so use the serving figure if that's a nutrient you're managing.

salmon-and-leek-rice-pie.text: About this meal: Salmon, leek and lemon make this rice pie rich and comforting, with the egg-and-milk mixture holding it together. Salmon supplies protein and omega-3 fats; the egg and dairy contribute more protein and phosphorus. The recorded phosphorus is substantial, so the whole serving deserves a look if you monitor it.
